camel_example: aliyun ccc ModifySkillGroup --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId '9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d' --SkillGroupId '0ead7334-83e7-42a0-a5bd-c2ef9f18ef28' --Name '售后技术支持技能组'
description_en: Modifies the name, description, outbound phone numbers, and agents of a skill group
description_zh: 修改技能组的名称、描述、外呼号码以及组内坐席
kebab_example: aliyun ccc modify-skill-group --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d --skill-group-id 0ead7334-83e7-42a0-a5bd-c2ef9f18ef28 --name '售后技术支持技能组' --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySkillGroup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance to which the skill group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待编辑技能组所属呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group to modify
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the skill group
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 售后技术支持人员使用
parameters.help_en: The new description of the skill group
parameters.help_zh: 技能组的新的简单描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the use of personal outbound phone numbers
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许使用个人外呼号码
parameters.name: allow_private_outbound_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the outbound phone number to associate with the skill group.


OutboundPhoneNumberId.1 indicates that only one outbound phone number is associated. To associate multiple phone numbers, specify multiple parameters, such as OutboundPhoneNumberId.1, OutboundPhoneNumberId.2, and OutboundPhoneNumberId.3
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定到技能组的外呼号码的号码ID。


参数名称OutboundPhoneNumberId.1意为只绑定一个外呼号码，如果绑定多个号码，则需要传多个，例如 OutboundPhoneNumberId.1、OutboundPhoneNumberId.2、OutboundPhoneNumberId.3，以此类推
parameters.name: outbound_phone_number_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the agent to add to the skill group.

UserId.1 indicates that only one agent is associated. To associate multiple agents, specify multiple parameters, such as UserId.1, UserId.2, and UserId.3. Note that UserId refers to the unique identifier of a RAM user within the Cloud Call Center instance, not the RamId of the RAM user
parameters.help_zh:
需要加入到技能组中的坐席ID。

UserId.1意为只绑定一个坐席，如果绑定多个，则需要传多个，例如 UserId.1、UserId.2、UserId.3，以此类推。注意UserId指RAM子账号在呼叫中心实例的唯一标识UserId，并非RAM子账号的RamId
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill level.

SkillLevel.1 sets the skill level for UserId.1. If multiple UserIds are specified, the same number of SkillLevel parameters must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
技能级别。

SkillLevel.1代表为UserId.1设置技能组等级，如果userId为多个，则SkillLevel也需要多个，并且数量需要保持一致
parameters.name: skill_level

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
